capabilities: Edit .json and .jsonc files in a tree or CodeMirror source view with undo, search and keyboard navigation
Preserve JSONC comments and formatting by applying tree edits as targeted text edits
Render ```json and ```jsonc code blocks and embedded .json files as collapsible trees in notes
Validate files against a companion JSON Schema file (opt-in)
Repair broken JSON via a configured LLM endpoint with a side-by-side diff before applying
extras: Conflicts with other plugins claiming the .json extension (JSON Viewer, JSON Collapsible, Data Files Editor) — only the file view is disabled in that case. Optional LLM repair sends the broken block to a user-configured endpoint (local, Anthropic, or OpenAI-compatible); no telemetry, and secrets in the block are masked before the request. Obsidian 1.11.4+ required.
motivation: Built for the author's personal use and released because it might be useful to others.
problem: Obsidian opens JSON files as unstyled plain text and JSON code blocks in notes render as hard-to-read raw text, with no structural editing, validation or navigation.

relations.evidence: With the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin installed, the endpoint, its API key and the model come from there
AnySource Sideloader installs and updates Obsidian plugins from any git forge

summary: JSON and JSONC file editor with a tree/source toggle, comment-preserving edits, schema validation, and rendered JSON code blocks in notes.
